title: Member of Technical Staff, Intelligence
description: LOCATION: King’s Cross, London · PATTERN: Hybrid, with regular time in the lab The opportunity We’re a stealth startup in AI and bio, building infrastructure for data generation. The team is small and elite, the problems are hard, and the foundations are being laid right now. You’d help write them from the first line, with real ownership and a direct line to the founders. This role builds our analysis from the start. Every result leaves an instrument as a trace or a vendor file, and it has to become a value someone can rely on, linked back to the sequence and sample it came from. That means fitting it properly, checking it against controls, catching the plate or reagent lot that drifted, and showing the evidence. Someone has to own that work. That is this role. About us AI for biology has a data problem. The data that matters most doesn’t exist yet, so we’re building the infrastructure to produce it, with quality and traceability built in from day one. We’re in stealth and heads-down on execution. We’ll share more about what we’re building once you’ve spoken with the team. The role You will join the intelligence team and own the analysis of our assay data, and the data and ML infrastructure it runs on, from the point the data has been captured to the result that gets delivered. You will work most closely with the protein characterisation scientists who run the assays, and with the software team, who get data out of the instruments and own the platform it lives on. You build on top of that platform, and you own the quality of the analysis that runs on it. The role is part data engineer and part biostatistician, and all of the data is biological. Much of it is building the analysis and ML pipelines that run on our captured data, and the statistics inside them. The rest is presenting those results clearly, with the statistics that matter, such as uncertainty and QC, shown in a form they can understand. The value is in doing that carefully, in code that behaves the same way on every run. What you will own ● Analysis and ML pipelines that turn captured assay and sequence data into consistent, versioned datasets, linked to the sequence, sample, plate and well each result came from, built with the software team who own data capture. ● Data validation before any analysis runs, catching a mislabelled plate, a swapped sample or a missing well. ● Sequence-level bioinformatics, such as computing the properties of each protein sequence and checking constructs for problems before the DNA is ordered. ● Biostatistics for experimental data: experimental design, replicates and controls, error propagation, outlier handling, and assay acceptance criteria, such as CV across replicates, Z′ for plate assays, and reference standards staying within range. ● Curve fitting, including dose-response (EC50 and IC50) with sound normalisation and fits to SPR, BLI, HPLC and nanoDSF traces, with a measure of confidence on each fitted parameter and automated QC that sends doubtful fits to a person. ● Detection of plate, lot and batch effects across a dataset before it is delivered, and control charting of reference standards so drift shows up over weeks as well as within a run. ● The data visualisation that accompanies each delivered result, showing it with its uncertainty, QC and batch structure, so anyone can understand and check it without asking us. Who you are You have worked with messy experimental data and built things other people relied on. That might have been in a biotech or pharma team, an academic lab, a core facility, or a data-heavy field outside biology where you have since picked up the biology. Nobody arrives with every part of this role. If you are strong in most of it and quick to learn the rest, we want to hear from you. You are happy to get your hands dirty on the data. Much of the job is careful, repeated work on real instrument output, and we want someone who takes pride in doing that well. You write code other people can run, and you care how a result reads to the person receiving it. Seniority is not what we are screening for. We are open to someone early in their career and to someone with many years behind them. What we look for is depth and judgement on experimental data. We do not hire people into boxes. This role will stretch past its description, sometimes into the lab and sometimes into conversations beyond the team. Early hires here are expected to pick up what is in front of them. Must have ● Building and running production data and ML pipelines, ideally on scientific or lab data, including data modelling, validation and reproducible, versioned workflows. ● Handling the specifics of biological data: plate layouts, sample and reagent lot lineage, and protein and DNA construct sequences with the standard tools for working with them. ● Biostatistics for experimental data, including experimental design, replicates and controls, curve fitting, and separating batch effects from biology. ● Statistical process control and anomaly detection, so assay drift and instrument variability are caught early. ● Data visualisation for people outside your team, presenting results with their uncertainty and QC so they can understand and check them themselves. ● Fluency in Python and its scientific stack, including pandas, NumPy and SciPy, and in working with coding agents. ● SQL and relational schema design for samples, plates and results. ● Turning scientists’ questions into requirements, and writing down the assumptions behind them. Nice to have ● Hands-on analysis of instrument output from a lab, especially trace-based data such as SPR or HPLC. ● R for statistical modelling, such as dose-response fitting or mixed models for plate and batch effects. ● Containers and cloud infrastructure, such as Docker, Kubernetes and AWS. ● Working with data from LIMS, electronic lab notebooks or lab data standards. ● Current protein language models and structure prediction, such as ESM C, Boltz-2, Chai, OpenFold3 or AlphaFold 3. Why this is unusual Most assay data analysis happens far from the lab, on files someone exported weeks earlier, with little record of how the experiment ran. Here you sit next to the lab, the conditions of every run are recorded, and your analysis is delivered alongside the data. The work also changes under you. The lab starts with people running the instruments and becomes automated over time, and the analysis you first build by hand becomes the checks that run on every result. Some people find that energising; some find it outside their lane. It’s worth knowing in advance which one you are. How we work The role is based in London, at our lab and office in King’s Cross. Time in person with the scientists matters for this work. The wider team is distributed and travels, so you will work with people who are not always in the building. We work in the open. Decisions are written down and work happens in Slack. The whole company meets once a week at the start of the week, and there is a regular offsite. Each person owns their area and makes the call inside it, and we will expect that of you early rather than late. UK benefits are 30 days of annual leave plus public holidays, a pension with a 10% employer contribution, and Bupa private health cover. More is added as the team grows. The team you will join You will report to the intelligence lead. You will also work closely with the founders and with the protein characterisation scientists whose data you will analyse. We are a small, elite team, weighted towards science and software. You will be the first person on the intelligence team whose focus is the analysis and ML infrastructure behind our results. Our process Our process has four stages. A short screening call about the role and the practicalities. A behavioural interview about how you work and what you value, run from the same template for every candidate. A technical stage built on a real analysis problem from our lab, not a puzzle. You spend a few hours writing up how you would approach it, using the tools you would use on the job, coding agents included, with a short note on the decisions you made. We care about judgement more than hours, so a focused answer beats an exhaustive one. We then go through it with you in person. Then references, aimed at whatever we still want to understand. If you are not sure whether you are a fit, apply anyway. We would rather read it and decide. We are an equal opportunity employer. We make hiring decisions on merit, scope-fit, and the strength of the working relationship we expect to build with each hire. Applications welcome from candidates of any background. Fin can also be combined with our natively integrated Intercom help desk, giving modern support teams one single system.</p> <p>Together with Salesforce, the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success, we're building the future of customer experience. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn't a buzzword, it's a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing, and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI.</p> <p>Ready to level up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You're in the right place. Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.</p></div><h2>What's the opportunity? </h2> <ul> <li>The Research, Analytics & Data Science (RAD) team at Fin use data and insights to drive evidence based decision-making. We're a team of data scientists and product researchers who use data — both big and small — to unlock actionable insights about our customers, our products and our business. We generate insights that build customer empathy, drive product strategy and shape products that deliver real value to our customers. If you get really excited about asking the right questions, exploring patterns in data and surfacing actionable insights that drive strategic decisions, then this role is for you.</li> <li>Data Scientists in RAD partner with teams across R&D to help Fin make sense of our users, our products and our business, using metrics and data. title: Staff Brand Designer
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong><em>🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.</em></strong></p> <p>We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.</p> <p>After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. As well as <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/personal">personal</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/business-banking">business</a> bank accounts, we offer <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/joint-account">joint accounts</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/16-17">accounts for 16-17 year olds</a>, a <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/under-16s">free kids account</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/flex">credit cards</a> in the UK, with more exciting things to come beyond. Our UK customers can also <a href="https://monzo.com/savings">save</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/investments">invest </a>and <a href="https://monzo.com/pensions">combine their pensions</a> with us. </p> <p>With our hot coral cards and get-paid-early feature, combined with financial education on social media and our award winning customer service, we have a long history of creating magical moments for our customers!</p> <p>We’re not about selling products - we want to solve problems and change lives through Monzo ❤️</p> <hr> <p> </p></div><p>📍 <strong>London </strong>| 💰 <strong>£98,000 - £114,000 + Incentive Awards tied to your performance</strong> |<a href="https://monzo.com/careers/"> Benefits</a> |<a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=U62l09nB0M4"> Hear from the team</a> ✨</p> <h4><strong>⭐ Our Design team</strong></h4> <p>We’re a team of 115+ designers, researchers and brand experts led by Chief Design Officer Vuokko Aro. We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.</p> <p>Our brand helps make Monzo recognisable and human, whether someone is opening the app, visiting our website or seeing a campaign for the first time. As we grow, there’s a big opportunity to evolve how our brand shows up and make those experiences feel connected.</p> <p>We’re looking for a <strong>Staff Brand Designer</strong> to help shape the future of Monzo’s visual identity, lead and develop designers, and set a high bar for creative work across the company.</p> <p>You’ll join our digital-first internal creative studio and work closely with our Global Creative Director, designers and writers. You’ll also partner with teams across Product Design and Marketing, as well as external agencies, to bring ambitious ideas to life.</p> <p>This is for a designer who loves getting into the detail as much as shaping the bigger picture and helping others grow. You’ll bring strong conceptual thinking, art direction and typography to your work, and support a team of designers to do their best work too.</p> <h4><strong>🔑 You’ll play a key role by…</strong></h4> <ul> <li><strong>Shaping our creative direction.</strong> Work with the Global Creative Director and partners across Monzo to evolve our visual identity and set a clear strategic direction for how the brand shows up globally.</li> <li><strong>Leading ambitious work. </strong>You’ll lead projects from idea to delivery and oversee work led by others, helping the team solve problems and deliver their best work. You’ll spot opportunities, create briefs and bring the right people together to make ideas happen. You’ll thrive working across multiple projects and teams at once.</li> <li><strong>Creating standout design.</strong> You’ll lead by example, setting a high bar for craft, concept and execution across the team. You’ll bring ideas to life across campaigns, marketing, product and other brand touch points, inspiring others through the quality of your work.</li> <li><strong>Managing and developing designers.</strong> Lead and support a small team of designers, helping them grow through regular feedback, coaching and career development conversations. Use Monzo’s levelling frameworks to support their progression and set clear expectations.</li> <li><strong>Raising the bar across the team.</strong> Lead critiques, share thoughtful feedback and mentor designers beyond your direct reports. Help create the conditions for people to do their best work.</li> <li><strong>Connecting brand and product.</strong> Partner with Product Design teams to bring Monzo’s brand to life in the app, including developing visual concepts, art direction and motion storyboards for customer experiences.</li> <li><strong>Evolving our brand systems.</strong> Develop guidelines, design principles and reusable assets that help teams create consistent, distinctive work as Monzo grows.</li> <li><strong>Influencing decisions across teams.</strong> Bring people together around a creative vision, explain the thinking behind your work and navigate trade-offs between customer needs, creative ambition and business goals.</li> <li><strong>Working with creative partners.</strong> Collaborate with external agencies and specialists, providing clear direction and feedback to make sure their work feels right for Monzo.</li> <li><strong>Improving how we work.</strong> Spot opportunities to make our creative process more effective, whether that’s through new tools, better ways of working or clearer guidance for teams.</li> </ul> <h4><strong>🤩 We’d love to hear from you if…</strong></h4> <ul> <li>You have a strong portfolio of brand design and campaign work, showing how you’ve developed distinctive creative ideas and brought them to life across different channels.</li> <li>You’re an expert in your craft, with particular strength in <strong>typography, visual identity and art direction</strong>. You care about the details and can show how they make the overall work stronger.</li> <li>You have <strong>experience managing and developing designers</strong>, including giving feedback, supporting career growth and helping people do their best work.</li> <li>You’ve led complex creative projects from brief to delivery, making decisions, bringing people with you and maintaining a high standard throughout.</li> <li>You can think beyond a single project: you’ve helped shape a brand’s direction, developed design systems or guidelines, or improved how creative work happens across a team or organisation.</li> <li>You’re comfortable working with ambiguity. You can define a direction, navigate competing priorities and make thoughtful trade-offs without losing sight of the bigger picture.</li> <li>You’re proactive, creating your own briefs, bringing the right people together to accomplish your goals. You’re not just a doer, but a problem solver and a self-starter.</li> <li>You enjoy working in a fast-paced environment, working across multiple teams and projects at the same time. </li> <li>You’re a confident collaborator who can explain and advocate for your ideas with designers, cross-functional partners and senior stakeholders.</li> <li>You enjoy raising the quality of design beyond your own work, through mentoring, critique and sharing what you know.</li> <li>You’re highly proficient in Figma and comfortable using the tools you need to develop and deliver your ideas. You have a clear interest in AI tools and are keen to explore and use them to evolve how we work and what we create across design, marketing and product.</li> <li>You have experience working in a digital-first brand, creative agency or in-house team, and can show how your work has supported customer or business goals.</li> <li>You can develop ideas for motion and communicate them through storyboards or creative direction. You don’t need to be a motion specialist.</li> </ul> <p>We’d also love to see experience across areas such as web design, campaigns, print, film, illustration or 3D. You don’t need to be an expert in all of them.</p> <h4><strong>🙌 What’s in it for you</strong></h4> <p>💰 <strong>£98,000 - £114,000 + Incentive Awards tied to your performance.</strong></p> <p>⏰ We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, and at times that suit you and your team.</p> <p>📚 £1,000 learning budget each year to use on books, training courses and conferences.</p> <p>🏡 We’ll set you up to work from home. All employees are given a MacBook.</p> <p>➕ Plus lots more! Take a look at our<a href="https://monzo.com/careers/"> benefits</a>.</p> <h4><strong>🌈 The application journey</strong></h4> <ul> <li><strong>30-minute call with our Recruiter</strong></li> <li><strong>1-hour craft interview where you’ll present a single case study to 2 members of our Brand Design team. </strong></li> <li><strong>1-hour interview covering values & ways of working. </strong></li> </ul> <p>To be considered for this role you will need to include your CV and a portfolio showcasing your work. This will allow us to better understand your experience. We’d particularly love to see projects you’ve led from start to finish, including the thinking behind the work, the impact it had and your individual contribution.</p> <p>We have some guidelines on using AI to support your application and interviews at Monzo.<a href="https://monzo.com/blog/the-ultimate-guide-on-using-ai-to-ace-an-interview-at-monzo"> You can read them here</a>.</p> <p>We’ll only close this role once we have enough applications for the next stage. Please submit your application as soon as possible to make sure you don’t miss out.</p> <p>#LI-TR1</p><div class="content-conclusion"><hr> <p><strong>Equal opportunities for everyone</strong></p> <p>Diversity and inclusion are a priority for us and we’re making sure we have lots of support for all of our people to grow at Monzo. At Monzo, we’re embracing diversity by fostering an inclusive environment for all people to do the best work of their lives with us. This is integral to our mission of making money work for everyone. You can read more in our <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/diversity-and-inclusion">blog</a>, 2026 <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/our-2026-diversity-and-inclusion-report" target="_blank">Diversity and Inclusion Report</a> and 2025 <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/gender-pay-gap-report-2025">Gender Pay Gap Report.</a></p> <p>We’re an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to age, ethnicity, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, or veteran, neurodiversity or disability status.</p> <p>If you have a preferred name, please use it to apply. We don't need full or birth names at application stage 😊</p></div>

title: Office Administrator
description: <p>Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1000+ colleagues in 70+ countries and very few roles based in offices. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.</p> <p>The company is founder led, profitable and growing. We are hiring <strong>London Office Administrators </strong>to help take responsibility for the success of our London office. </p> <p>Our office administrators are part of our global business services team which covers business services, travel and logistics, events, expense management and administration. We look for positive team players who are self-driven and results oriented, with excellent attention to detail. The best candidates show that they are forward planners, reliable and determined, and keen to assume responsibility for projects, processes and policy. We are a unique global business, so we are not looking for candidates with extensive experience so much as excellent organisers and communicators who are keen to develop skills and strive for continuous improvement.</p> <p><strong>Location:</strong> This is an office-based role based in London.</p> <h3>What your day will look like</h3> <ul> <li>Create a professional, positive and welcoming environment for colleagues and guests</li> <li>Proactive management of front-of-house, meeting rooms and desk space</li> <li>Clerical, administrative and logistical tasks such as ordering supplies, office equipment, and processing invoices</li> <li>Creating and maintaining relationships with internal and external stakeholders</li> <li>Cross team collaboration across the company</li> </ul> <h3>What we are looking for</h3> <ul> <li>Excellent academics</li> <li>Excellent spoken and written English skills</li> <li>Responsible and accountable</li> <li>Self-awareness and thoughtfulness</li> <li>Ability to travel up to twice a year for company events of up to two weeks duration</li> <li>Ability to grasp our existing technical systems and suggest improvements</li> <li>Strong problem-solving skills with attention to detail</li> <li>Excellent communication and interpersonal skills</li> <li>Adaptability in a fast-paced, ever-changing environment</li> </ul> <h3>What we offer you</h3> <p>We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.</p> <ul> <li>Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year</li> <li>Annual compensation review</li> <li>Recognition rewards</li> <li>Annual holiday leave</li> <li>Maternity and paternity leave</li> <li>Pension and medical insurance</li> <li>Employee Assistance Program</li> <li>Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues</li> <li>Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events</li> </ul> <h3>About Canonical</h3> <p>Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world on a daily basis. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Canonical has been a remote-first company since its inception in 2004.​ Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.</p> <h3>Canonical is an equal opportunity employer</h3> <p>We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. <a href="https://canonical.com/careers/diversity/identity">Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.</a></p>

title: Forward Deployed Architect
description: WHO WE ARE Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion. Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work. ABOUT THE ROLE: As a Forward Deployed Architect on Notion’s Services team, you will help customers turn AI ambition into operational reality and unlock the full potential of our platform. You will partner directly with customers to design, build, and launch AI-native workflows that drive adoption, usage, and measurable business outcomes. This role sits at the center of Notion’s workflow-led GTM motion. You will partner directly with customers to understand their business goals, operating processes, technical environment, governance needs, and adoption barriers, then translate that context into scalable Notion architectures that drive measurable value. You will be hands-on across discovery, solution design, workspace architecture, workflow build, AI implementation, launch planning, adoption and handoff. You will work deeply with customers to define what Notion should own, where it should integrate with existing systems, and how Notion can become a durable operating layer for their teams. The best candidates combine strong consultative discovery, systems thinking, technical fluency, AI-native workflow design, implementation judgment and exceptional customer presence. You should be comfortable reasoning through technical tradeoffs, designing scalable solutions, and partnering closely with Forward Deployed Engineering when deeper engineering support is required. WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE: - Partner with customers on forward deployed engagements from discovery through launch, translating business goals and workflow requirements into scalable clear solution design and Notion solutions that drive durable adoption. - Design scalable Notion architectures that translate customer workflows, permission and governance needs, integrations and AI use cases into optimal workspaces that are easy to adopt, manage and scale. - Design and deploy AI-native workflows using Notion AI, custom agents, automations, Workers, Developer Platform capabilities and adjacent AI tools, partnering with Forward Deployed Engineering when advanced technical depth is needed for migrations, API constraints, security architecture or frontier implementation. - Help customers navigate change by designing adoption plans, enablement materials and launch approaches that drive sustained usage and measurable business value. - Identify repeatable patterns across customer engagements and convert them into packaged solutions, templates, reference architectures, run books, enablement assets and product feedback. - Serve as a trusted advisor to customers, simplifying complex technical requirements, making practical tradeoff recommendations and helping stakeholders align around a clear implementation path. - Partner cross-functionally with GTM, Product, Engineering, PMM, Services leadership and the partner ecosystem to scale what works beyond individual customer engagements. - Create clear implementation plans, handoff materials and success measures that align customers and internal teams on the path to value. SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: - 5+ years of experience in tech services/consulting, solutions architecture, implementation, customer engineering, or a similar customer-facing role. - Proven ability to translate ambiguous customer goals into clear workflows, implementation plans, solution architectures, and measurable success criteria. - Strong consultative discovery skills, including the ability to map current-state workflows, identify customer pain, understand operating models, surface technical constraints, and define practical future-state solutions. - Hands-on AI builder mindset, with experience using AI tools to design, prototype, automate, or improve real business workflows. - Technical fluency with APIs, integrations, data models, automation, enterprise systems, developer workflows and implementation tradeoffs. You do not need to write production code but you should be able to reason through technical constraints and troubleshoot effectively. - Strong experience delivering implementations that drive adoption, change management and long-term customer value. - Strong project and engagement management skills, including ownership of scope, timeline, deliverables, stakeholder alignment, risks, decisions, dependencies and launch readiness. - Exceptional written and verbal communication, with the ability to simplify complex technical concepts for business, technical, and executive audiences. - Strong executive presence and customer judgment, with the ability to build trust, frame tradeoffs clearly, and move ambiguous decisions forward. - Bias toward action, high learning velocity, and comfort building in fast-changing AI-native product environments. NICE TO HAVES: - Experience designing or deploying Agents, automations or AI-powered workflows with Customers. - Experience with Notion, APIs, MCPs, Workers, coding agents or developer platform workflows. - Experience developing discovery methodologies, reusable delivery assets, internal tooling, packaged services or reference architectures from the ground up. - Experience partnering with Product and Engineering teams to turn field learnings into roadmap signal, reusable architecture patterns or scalable product improvements. - Previous experience in a fast-paced, high-growth technology environment. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement — when that’s the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on. EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & ACCOMMODATIONS We hire talented people from a wide range of backgrounds. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every bullet, we still encourage you to apply. Notion is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of any legally protected characteristic. Consistent with applicable law, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. Notion provides reasonable accommodations during the application process; if you need one, please let your recruiter know. Notion is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate in hiring or any employment decision based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. Notion considers qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please let your recruiter know.

£75,000. </p> <p>📍This role can be based in our London or Cardiff office, but we're open to distributed working within the UK (with ad hoc meetings in London) </p> <p>⏰ We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, and at times that suit you and your team. </p> <p>📚 £1,000 learning budget each year to use on books, training courses and conferences.</p> <p>🏡 We will set you up to work from home; all employees are given Macbooks and for fully remote workers we will provide extra support for your work-from-home setup. </p> <p>➕ Plus lots more!<a href="https://monzo.com/careers/"> Read our full list of benefits</a>.</p> <p><strong>🌈 The application journey has 4 key steps</strong></p> <ul> <li>Recruiter Screening Conversation </li> <li>Initial HM Interview </li> <li>Role Specific Interview </li> <li>Behavioural Interview </li> </ul> <p>This process should take around 3-4 weeks - and communication skills, with the ability to explain complex tax concepts to non-tax stakeholders.</li> <li><span style="font-weight: 300;">Business level written and spoken English</span> with style="font-weight: 300;">International travel 2-4 times a year for company events up to two weeks long.</span></li> </ul> <p><span style="font-weight: 300;">In addition we expect that you will match 300;"><span style="font-weight: 300;">Reliable, delivering high quality work that builds trust and confidence.</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 300;"><span style="font-weight: 300;">Accessible, collaborating to build products and systems that are usable.</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 300;"><span style="font-weight: 300;">Adroit, blending enthusiasm, knowledge, adaptability, style and character.</span></li> </ul> <h3><strong>Nice-to-have skills</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Leadership ability</li> <li>Software or tech industry experience</li> <li>Public company finance and reporting description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong><em>🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.</em></strong></p> <p>We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.</p> <p>After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. We work alongside our first line credit teams who design the products, decide who to lend to, set underwriting policy, identify customers who need help, manage the portfolio and report and measure credit risk.</p> <p>Within CIF, we are scaling up our Forecasting modelling and execution team to support the enhancement of modelling standards across Finance. The role holder will have the opportunity to lead a ‘consultancy style’ centre of excellence providing thought leadership on the methodological design and regulatory compliance assessment on all Financial forecasting models that feed the banks’ budgeting and stress-testing activities. This will expand to hands-on delivery of model developments, where appropriate. </p> <p>Strong data and analytical skills are a must, as is experience in financial modelling and coding (Python and SQL preferred). Experience working in regulatory stress testing exercises (such as ICAAP or EBA Stress-testing) is highly desirable but not essential. </p> <p>We rely heavily on the following tools and technologies (note we do not expect applicants to have prior experience of all them):</p> <ul> <li><a href="https://cloud.google.com/">Google Cloud Platform</a> for all of our analytics infrastructure</li> <li><a href="https://www.getdbt.com/">dbt</a> and<a href="https://cloud.google.com/bigquery/"><strong> </strong>BigQuery SQL</a> for our data modelling and warehousing</li> <li>Python for data science and predictive modelling and data visualisation (via streamlit)</li> <li>Anaplan for model implementation</li> <li>Github for version control</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>🔑 You’ll play a key role by...</strong></p> <ul> <li>Assisting with continuous improvement of forecasting models via individual delivery or through others</li> <li>Development of best practices for financial modelling across Monzo</li> <li>Presenting forecast model results to senior management</li> <li>Close collaboration with portfolio strategy, model validation, finance and external audit teams</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>🤩 We’d love to hear from you if…</strong></p> <ul> <li>You have a background in financial forecast modelling or execution</li> <li>You have strong analytical skills and a track record of using these to deliver technical projects</li> <li>You have a solid technical toolkit. SQL and Python are our desired coding languages but experience in SAS/R will be considered. A data visualisation tool (such as Streamlit or Looker) is a plus</li> <li>You can convey problems and solutions using clear and simple language, both written and verbal (see <a href="https://monzo.com/tone-of-voice/">Monzo’s tone of voice</a> guide). This is particularly important for communicating complex issues and priorities to non-experts</li> <li>You're impact driven and eager to have a real positive impact on the company, our products, our users and your team-mates</li> <li>You have a self-starter mindset<em>;</em> you proactively identify issues and opportunities and tackle them without being told to do so</li> <li>You're a team player<em> </em>whom your colleagues can rely on</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>🌈 The application journey has 4 key steps</strong></p> <ol> <li>Initial call with a member of the Forecasting team</li> <li>Technical modelling interview </li> <li>Values and collaboration behavioural interview</li> <li>A live case study problem solving interview</li> </ol> <p>Our average process takes around 3-4 weeks but we will always work around your availability.</p> <p> </p> <p><strong>🙌 What’s in it for you</strong></p> <p>💰 £79,000 to £106,800 + <a href="https://monzo.com/careers/">benefits</a>  </p> <p>📍 London (one day a week)</p> <p>✈️ We can help you relocate to the UK</p> <p>✅ We can sponsor visas</p> <p>⏰ We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, at times that suit you and your team.</p> <p>📚Learning budget of £1,000 a year for books, training courses and conferences</p> <p>➕And much more, see our full list of benefits <a href="https://monzo.com/careers/">here</a></p> <p> </p> <p><span class="notion-enable-hover" data-token-index="0">#LI-JH1</span></p><div class="content-conclusion"><hr> <p><strong>Equal opportunities for everyone</strong></p> <p>Diversity and inclusion are a priority for us and we’re making sure we have lots of support for all of our people to grow at Monzo. description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong><em>🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.</em></strong></p> <p>We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.</p> <p>After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. This is a rare opportunity to shape one of Monzo’s most strategically important product areas, leading teams to build innovative, differentiated experiences that no other bank offers.</p> <p>You’ll set the long-term vision, craft a customer-obsessed strategy, and create the execution engine that turns ambition into reality. We’re looking for someone who pairs exceptional product taste with strong analytical depth, thrives in ambiguity, and can inspire multiple teams to deliver world-class outcomes.</p> <p>If you’re excited by the idea of redefining business banking for millions of customers—and building high-performing teams along the way—this role puts you at the heart of Monzo’s next chapter.</p> <p><strong>What you’ll be working on:</strong></p> <p>As the Senior Product Director for Business Banking, you will define and drive the product strategy, vision, and execution for one of Monzo’s most strategically important product areas. You’ll craft an ambitious roadmap rooted in deep customer insight, emerging market dynamics, and commercial impact—setting a vision that differentiates Monzo in the business banking space.</p> <p>This role is a rare blend of strategic thinking, world-class product taste, analytical depth, and an ability to consistently ship great work. You will cultivate a high-performance, ownership-driven culture across multiple product teams, guiding them to innovate, execute, and scale products that meaningfully improve the financial lives of our business customers.</p> <p><strong>What you'll do:</strong></p> <p><strong>Product Strategy & Vision</strong></p> <ul> <li>Set a bold, customer-centric, commercially grounded product strategy for Business Banking.</li> <li>Develop and articulate a compelling long-term product vision that positions Monzo as the leader in differentiated business financial experiences.</li> <li>Combine customer insights, market trends, and commercial priorities into a roadmap that delivers measurable business impact.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Innovation & Differentiation</strong></p> <ul> <li>Foster a culture of innovation that challenges conventions and inspires teams to build category-defining experiences.</li> <li>Identify and pursue opportunities to meaningfully differentiate Monzo’s business banking offerings.</li> <li>Drive teams to create unique, delightful products based on exceptional product taste.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Analytical & Strategic Depth</strong></p> <ul> <li>Spar with data scientists and use data to understand “the why” behind customer behaviour, product performance, and opportunities.</li> <li>Help teams deepen their analytical thinking, improving decision-making quality across the org.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Execution & High-Performance Culture</strong></p> <ul> <li>Build an execution engine that consistently delivers against ambitious goals.</li> <li>Create extreme clarity on priorities, establish strong processes, remove blockers, and maintain team momentum.</li> <li>Instil a culture of ownership, speed, and high performance.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Leadership & Organisational Impact</strong></p> <ul> <li>Be a self-starter with a strong bias for action—willing to lead from the front when needed and empower from behind when that’s best.</li> <li>Take full ownership of the Business Banking product area, operating with autonomy and accountability.</li> <li>Identify organisational inefficiencies and design structures that enable teams to thrive.</li> <li>Hire, coach, and develop exceptional product managers, helping them reach their full potential and cultivating the next generation of Monzo product leaders.</li> </ul> <p><strong>You should apply if:</strong></p> <ul> <li>You are a seasoned product leader, and have a track record of leading high-performing product teams at a fast-growing consumer tech company to:</li> <ul> <li>build highly engaging (daily/weekly) experiences for millions of customers</li> <li>deliver company trajectory-changing impact</li> <li>(nice-to-have) build a multi-market product, with a proven ability to balance priorities across geographies</li> </ul> <li>You're data-driven and commercial, and have a track record of collaborating with data scientists to define key metrics, run experiments, and deliver business impact.</li> <li>You can systematically break down and solve complex problems.</li> <li>You have good judgement, and you’re able to make good decisions in complex situations where there’s often no “right answer”. </li> <li>You have the urge and resilience to challenge the status quo and make things better, and are full of creative ideas for how to do so.</li> <li>You can work effectively with a diverse range of people and working styles - spanning engineering, design, data, user research, marketing, legal and compliance - to get stuff done.</li> <li>You’re a great storyteller, who is able to motivate, energise and inspire people towards a common goal.</li> <li>You’re passionate about building value for customers and not just achieving business results, and are excited about our mission at Monzo.</li> <li>You’re intellectually honest about your work's performance, continually striving for improvement. </li> <li>You’re a fast learner, humble and curious, and enjoy learning every day and sharing your knowledge and experience.</li> <li>You’ve managed a team of PMs, have a proven ability to coach and develop others, and can provide clear and constructive feedback to your team and other disciplines.</li> <li>You can get hands-on when necessary, to fill gaps - in people or experience - and set a practical example for what great looks like.</li> </ul> <p><strong>What’s in it for you:</strong></p> <p>💰Base salary dependent upon experience + Stock Options + Benefits</p> <p>✈️ We can help you relocate to the UK  </p> <p>✅ We can sponsor visas</p> <p>📍This role can be based in our London office, but we're open to distributed working within the UK (with ad hoc meetings in London).</p> <p>⏰ We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, at times that suit you and your team.</p> <p>📚Learning budget of £1,000 a year for books, training courses and conferences</p> <p>➕And much more, Canonical solutions.</p> <p>Location: Office Based in London, England.</p> <h2><strong>The role entails</strong></h2> <ul> <li><strong>Empathetic Engagement:</strong> Partner directly with customers description: WHO WE ARE Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion. Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work. ABOUT THE ROLE: The Solutions Consultant Manager is the person who makes our GTM motion real on the ground. As an in-region leader directly managing a team of Solutions Consultants, you'll own your team's full commercial output—new logo, expansion, and renewals—and be accountable for both the results and the quality of execution that produces them. This isn't a traditional pipeline-management role. The best SC Managers are coaches first: they know what a great first meeting looks like, can watch a live build and tell a rep exactly what to change, and build the operating rhythm and inspection cadence that makes consistent execution possible across the team. If you're a builder who loves developing people as much as winning deals—and you want to lead a regional team in a go-to-market model that's genuinely new—this is the role. This role will be based in London, UK. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days. WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE: - Own the commercial performance of your team across new logo ARR, expansion ARR, and UBP outcomes—accountable for both the headline numbers and the quality of execution that drives them - Coach SCs on the GTM builder motion: what great looks like in a first meeting (workflow diagnosis, current → future architecture), a second meeting (live build in Notion + value narrative), and through the full cycle to adoption hand-off - Contribute to and participate in the regional operating cadence: weekly pipeline reviews, deal support sessions, call reviews against the motion quality rubric, and forecast calls with senior leadership - Hire, onboard, and certify new SCs to the GTM builder motion—driving readiness from ramp through consistent execution, and managing performance with clarity when expectations aren't met - Partner with the regional BDR manager on pipeline strategy, outbound targeting, and qualification standards to ensure the team's book of business is healthy and growing - Partner with Outcomes leadership on adoption hand-offs, at-risk account management, and renewal strategy—owning the overall commercial arc for the region while collaborating on the execution that follows close - Represent your team or region in leadership forums with clear signal on what's working, what needs investment, and where execution is breaking down SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: - Track record as a quota-carrying B2B seller with direct experience in workflow design, live demos, or technical sales—you can coach the builder motion because you've run it yourself - Frontline sales management experience: built an operating cadence, ran performance management, and developed talent from onboarding through consistent overperformance - Strong coaching orientation: you can watch a demo or deal review and identify specifically what to change—not just whether the outcome was good, but why, and what the rep should do differently next time - title: Manager, Forward Deployed Engineer
description: WHO WE ARE Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion. Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work. ABOUT THE ROLE As a Manager of Forward Deployed Engineering on Notion’s Services team, you will lead a team responsible for the hands-on technical delivery of our most complex customer engagements. Your team will design, build, and deploy production-ready solutions that help enterprise customers integrate Notion as the operating layer for their business. You will combine people leadership, technical judgment, and customer-facing delivery. You will coach Forward Deployed Engineers through discovery, architecture, implementation, and launch while remaining close enough to the work to guide difficult technical decisions, unblock delivery, and build trust with senior customer stakeholders. The team’s work includes custom code, production-grade agents and AI workflows using MCP, Agent APIs, and Notion’s automation and execution infrastructure, as well as integrations, data pipelines, enterprise migrations, and complex challenges involving scale, permissions, and governance. You will help establish how Services delivers complex technical implementations across EMEA. This includes building a high-performing team, improving delivery standards and reusable technical assets, partnering with Sales, Product, CX, and Engineering, and turning lessons from customer deployments into product and platform improvements. WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE - Lead, coach, and develop a team of Forward Deployed Engineers delivering complex enterprise customer engagements across EMEA. - Create a high-performance team environment with clear expectations, strong technical standards, effective feedback, and meaningful career development. - Own the quality and outcomes of engagements from technical discovery and requirements gathering through solution design, implementation, launch, and handover. - Act as a trusted technical and delivery advisor to customer engineering, IT, security, and business leaders, helping them make informed architectural decisions and deepen their use of Notion. - Guide the design, build, and operation of custom agents, integrations, automations, and data pipelines that connect Notion with customers’ systems and workflows. - Oversee large-scale content and data migrations, including discovery, scoping, data modeling, transformation logic, validation, cutover, and post-migration optimization. - Review technical designs and implementation plans, identify delivery risks early, and step in directly when an engagement requires senior technical leadership. - Partner with Sales and Services leaders on qualification, feasibility, scoping, effort estimation, staffing, and delivery planning for strategic opportunities. - Balance customer priorities, team capacity, and technical complexity to make sound staffing and sequencing decisions. - Help define and scale the operating model for Forward Deployed Engineering, including hiring, onboarding, delivery methodologies, quality reviews, documentation, and engineering best practices. SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING - 8+ years of experience in forward deployed engineering, solutions engineering, professional services, customer engineering, software engineering, or a similar hands-on technical role. - 2+ years of experience managing, coaching, or leading engineers responsible for customer-facing technical delivery. - A strong track record of hiring, developing, and retaining high-performing technical teams. - Proficiency in at least one programming language such as Java, JavaScript, Node.js, SQL, or Python, with the technical depth to review production-quality code and guide implementation decisions. - Hands-on experience with APIs, integrations, authentication, data transformation, and production systems. - Experience leading technical discovery, assessing feasibility, identifying risks, scoping work, estimating effort, and translating ambiguous requirements into executable plans. - Strong architectural judgment and debugging skills, with the ability to isolate root causes across code, APIs, permissions, integrations, data quality, automation logic, system limits, and customer-specific environments. - Demonstrated success managing multiple complex customer engagements while maintaining quality, team health, and clear stakeholder communication. - Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to influence technical and business audiences from practitioners through executive stakeholders. - A customer- and outcomes-oriented approach, with sound judgment about when to standardize, when to customize, and how to manage tradeoffs. NICE TO HAVES - Experience building or scaling a Forward Deployed Engineering, professional services, or customer engineering function in a startup or high-growth environment. - Experience deploying AI agents in complex coding or business workflows. - Experience designing or implementing AI-powered workflows involving MCP, APIs, LLM applications, prompt engineering, retrieval or RAG systems, or workflow orchestration. - Experience with ETL or ELT workflows, schema mapping, validation scripts, and large-scale content or data migration tooling. - Experience partnering with product and engineering teams to influence roadmaps or architectural decisions based on customer implementation needs. - Experience supporting pre-sales and early engagement phases, including technical discovery, migration scoping, feasibility analysis, effort estimation, prototypes, and custom scripts. - Experience establishing technical delivery standards, quality review processes, discovery methodologies, or internal engineering tooling from the ground up. - A strong track record of successful enterprise implementations across multiple industries or regions. title: Product Marketing Manager
description: At Linear, we're building the product development system for teams and agents. AI is fundamentally changing how software gets built, and we’re shaping the tools this new era requires. Founded in 2019, Linear has become the platform of choice for more than 50,000 companies (including OpenAI, Coinbase, and Ramp) to plan, build, and ship their products. Today, our team is distributed across North America, Europe, and Australia, and we’re continuing to grow internationally. What unites us is relentless focus, fast execution, and a deep care for software craftsmanship. We’re hiring a Product Marketing Manager to help shape how Linear’s products are brought to market and understood by customers. This role sits at the intersection of Product, Engineering, Design, CX, Sales, and Marketing, and is responsible for turning technically sophisticated product work into clear narratives, strong launches, and high-quality customer-facing experiences. You’ll go deep on the product, define positioning and messaging, and drive execution across the surfaces that matter most—from in-product copy and changelogs to enablement, documentation inputs, email, and launch communications. This is a hands-on role for someone who combines product judgment, excellent writing, and strong cross-functional leadership. Location & work mode Linear is a remote-first company, with optional co-working offices in San Francisco, New York, and London. This role is open to candidates based in North America and the United Kingdom. You can work from anywhere within these regions. We value deep focus and async collaboration, with intentional moments to connect in person through team off-sites, optional co-working, and occasional travel. What you’ll do - Develop positioning, messaging, and core narratives for feature releases, key launches, and strategic product narratives - Partner closely with Product management, Engineering, and Design to refine how products are presented across in-product and external surfaces - Create and coordinate launch deliverables such as changelogs, demos, enablement materials, email, social copy, and go-to-market communications - Equip Sales, CX, and other customer-facing teams with the context and materials they need to communicate new launches effectively - Bring customer insight, product understanding, and market context back into product and launch decisions What we’re looking for - Exceptional writing and editorial judgment, with the ability to make complex ideas feel clear and compelling - Strong positioning and messaging skills grounded in customer problems, product truth, and differentiation - Great project management skills and ability to track large amounts of detail. - Comfort going deep on product details and building credibility with Product, Engineering, and Design - Strong judgment, ownership, and the ability to operate autonomously while maintaining a high quality bar What we offer We're a small, focused team that cares deeply about the quality of our work and the people we do it with.
